test_shift_basic: test the DataFrame.shift method shifts rows by a given number of periods
test_shift_axis1: test the DataFrame.shift method shifts columns along axis 1 with a fill value
test_shift_fill_value: test the DataFrame.shift method fills shifted gaps with a custom scalar value
test_shift_with_freq: test the DataFrame.shift method shifts DatetimeIndex by a frequency offset
test_shift_with_iterable: test the DataFrame.shift method shifts each column by a different period from an iterable
test_shift_categorical: test the DataFrame.shift method shifts categorical data preserving categories
test_shift_periodindex: test the DataFrame.shift method shifts PeriodIndex with a frequency string
